Closes #4599

## 📝 Summary (1-2 sentences)
Documents the Cargo Vet release workflow in the release management guide so Rust dependency updates have clear options before release CI fails. Covers imported audits, diff audits, full audits, temporary exemptions, skipping updates, and matching handling for `cpex-plugins`.
